entries.name: META_APP_ID
entries.description: Meta app for Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp.
howToGet: At developers.facebook.com, create a Business app and copy its App ID.

entries.name: META_APP_SECRET
howToGet: In the Meta app, go to Settings > Basic and copy the App Secret.

entries.name: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: System-user token for the WhatsApp Business API.
howToGet: In Meta Business Settings, create a system user, assign the WhatsApp app, and generate a permanent token.

entries.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
entries.description: The WhatsApp business phone number's id (not the number itself).
howToGet: In the Meta app, go to WhatsApp > API Setup and copy the Phone number ID.
